title: A morning shortlist of orders worth taking
lead: Collects orders from open marketplaces, decides take or skip by seven rules, and sends a short morning summary to Telegram.

hero.caption: The morning summary in Telegram: 16 orders from 3 channels, why one channel is silent (HTTP 403), and for each order the platform, budget, reply count and age (in Russian).
hero.alt: The morning summary in Telegram: 16 orders from 3 channels, why one channel is silent (HTTP 403), and for each order the platform, budget, reply count and age (in Russian).

problem: Orders appear on a dozen platforms at once, with a lot of noise: job ads, reviews, filler. Good orders go within hours. The need was a short list instead of scrolling feeds.
built: Collection without logging in to any account, one page at a time, with a 10-second pause.
The same order found on several platforms becomes one line.
7 selection rules: order vs job ad, kind of work, budget floor, number of replies, requests for access, deadline, diploma requirement.
A status line: how many were collected and which channels are silent and why.
If a platform adds protection or changes layout, the channel is reported silent, not hidden.

shots.caption: Verdicts: each skip names the rule that caused it (in Russian).
shots.alt: Verdicts: each skip names the rule that caused it (in Russian).

steps: The bot visits your chosen open sources on a polite schedule.
Duplicates of the same order are merged into one.
Seven plain rules mark each order take or skip, and every skip names its rule.
Every morning a short summary arrives in Telegram: only suitable orders, freshest first.
offer: Setup for your kinds of work and your budget floor.
not_included: Auto-replies; Closed channels or logins; CAPTCHA bypass; Hosting.
